steps.evidence: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1] if i>0 else 0, weight + (dp[p] if p>=0 else 0)); 不变量 dp 单调且最优子结构

solution.code:
def max_weight_nonoverlap(jobs: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    if not jobs:
        return 0
    import bisect
    jobs.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    n = len(jobs)
    ends = [job[1] for job in jobs]
    dp = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        start, end, weight = jobs[i]
        p = bisect.bisect_right(ends, start) - 1
        take = weight + (dp[p] if p >= 0 else 0)
        not_take = dp[i-1] if i > 0 else 0
        dp[i] = max(take, not_take)
    return dp[-1]

def count_pairs_in_range(nums: list[int], low: int, high: int) -> int:
    import bisect
    if len(nums) < 2:
        return 0
    s = sorted(nums)
    n = len(s)
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        target_low = low - s[i]
        target_high = high - s[i]
        left = bisect.bisect_left(s, target_low, i + 1)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(s, target_high, i + 1)
        ans += right - left
    return ans

solution.code:
import bisect

def max_weight_with_cooldown(jobs: list[list[int]], cool: int) -> int:
    if not jobs:
        return 0
    jobs_sorted = sorted(jobs, key=lambda x: x[1])
    n = len(jobs_sorted)
    starts = [job[0] for job in jobs_sorted]
    ends = [job[1] for job in jobs_sorted]
    weights = [job[2] for job in jobs_sorted]
    dp = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = bisect.bisect_right(ends, starts[i] - cool, 0, i) - 1
        include = weights[i] + (dp[j] if j >= 0 else 0)
        exclude = dp[i-1] if i > 0 else 0
        dp[i] = max(exclude, include)
    return dp[-1]

def linear_recurrence(a: int, b: int, f0: int, f1: int, n: int, mod: int) -> int:
    if n == 0:
        return f0 % mod
    if n == 1:
        return f1 % mod
    a %= mod
    b %= mod
    f0 %= mod
    f1 %= mod
    M = [[a, b], [1 % mod, 0]]
    def mat_mul(A, B):
        return [
            [(A[0][0]*B[0][0] + A[0][1]*B[1][0]) % mod,
             (A[0][0]*B[0][1] + A[0][1]*B[1][1]) % mod],
            [(A[1][0]*B[0][0] + A[1][1]*B[1][0]) % mod,
             (A[1][0]*B[0][1] + A[1][1]*B[1][1]) % mod]
        ]
    def mat_pow(M, power):
        res = [[1 % mod, 0], [0, 1 % mod]]
        while power > 0:
            if power & 1:
                res = mat_mul(res, M)
            M = mat_mul(M, M)
            power >>= 1
        return res
    Mn = mat_pow(M, n-1)
    return (Mn[0][0] * f1 + Mn[0][1] * f0) % mod
